description: Amends Rosewood Parcel V plan for residential development.
Adds a local road and lane to the parcel.
Reduces estimated population for the area.
Will include street townhouses, duplexes, and single-family homes.

chips.text: Future homeowners in Rosewood Parcel V will have varied housing options.
Exact number of future units and population for the parcel remains unquantified.
City will be responsible for maintenance of the new local road and lane.

description: Approves a daycare centre at 2610 14th Street East.
Serves up to 40 children and 5 staff.
Requires relocating two power poles at applicant's cost.

chips.text: Four residents raised concerns about lane use, parking, and traffic.
Applicant committed to keeping the back alley clean and one-way for drop-offs.

description: Public hearings approved rezonings for Stonebridge, Rosewood, and other areas.
Discretionary uses for a car wash and commercial school were approved.

chips.text: Rezonings approved for properties at 455 Lo and Way, 727 and 833 Heart Road.
